description: This source file defines an abstract class 'MessagingOptions' that encapsulates global messaging configurations for Orleans, including timeout settings, message size limits, and retry policies.

classes.name: MessagingOptions
classes.description: An abstract class representing common global messaging options for Orleans, including timeout, size limits, and message dropping policies.

methods.name: ResponseTimeout
methods.description: Gets or sets the default response timeout, considering whether a debugger is attached.

methods.name: ResponseTimeoutWithDebugger
methods.description: Gets or sets the response timeout duration when a debugger is attached, defaulting to 30 minutes.

methods.name: DropExpiredMessages
methods.description: Indicates whether messages should be dropped if they expire before delivery.

methods.name: ConfiguredResponseTimeout
methods.description: Underlying response timeout value without debugger check.

methods.name: CancelRequestOnTimeout
methods.description: Indicates if request cancellation should be attempted upon timeout.

methods.name: WaitForCancellationAcknowledgement
methods.description: Indicates if local calls should wait for cancellation acknowledgment.
